claims: Mark Few is the head men's basketball coach at Gonzaga University.
Mark Few has held the position of head men's basketball coach at Gonzaga University since 1999.
As of March 2026, Mark Few continues to lead the No. 3 seeded Zags (31-3) into the NCAA Tournament.
The Zags are No. 3 seeded as of March 2026.
The Zags have a 31-3 record as of March 2026.
Brian Michaelson is Head Coach in Waiting.
Jorge Sanz is Assistant Coach/Dir. of Basketball Operations.
Roger Powell Jr. is Assistant Coach.
Lisa Fortier is Women's Basketball Head Coach at Gonzaga University
